|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 5) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Rescue In The Clouds (V) (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V9-L-Rescue_In_The_Clouds_(V)-2021-03.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V9-L-Rescue_In_The_Clouds_(V)-2021-03-28-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V9-L-Rescue_In_The_Clouds_(V)-errata-sheet-2021-03-14.png]], 14 March 2021) → [[File:V9-L-Rescue_In_The_Clouds_(V)-2021-03-28-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V9-L-Rescue_In_The_Clouds_(V)-2021-03.gif]], 28 March 2021). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints “E”, but this is errata 2 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Rescue In The Clouds (V)]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-rescueinthecloudsv022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/rescueintheclouds.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual9-Light/large/rescueintheclouds.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Rescue In The Clouds”. Text: “USED: Peek at the top 3 cards of your Reserve Deck and take one into hand; reshuffle. OR Cancel a just drawn destiny targeting the ability or defense value of your non-Undercover character of ability < 5 at a system or mobile location. LOST: Cancel Close Call.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Rescue In The Clouds (V) (Errata)]]): Errata-sheet slip, Errata Sheet 2021 Spring (official text as of 19 March 2021)<ref name="sheet-2021-03-14">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/errata_032021.pdf Errata Sheet 2021 Spring] (Players Committee), page 2; PDF built 14 March 2021. Listed on the PC's [https://web.archive.org/web/20240920164229/https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Virtual slips page] (Internet Archive, 20 September 2024).</ref> — the cut-out slip the PC published for sleeving over the card (an errata-sheet slip is its own version, separate from the PC card image of the same errata; Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed:''' “USED: Peek at the top 3 cards of your Reserve Deck and take one into hand; reshuffle. OR Cancel a” → “USED: At a system or Bespin location, choose: Cancel a”; “ability < 5 at a system or mobile location. LOST: Cancel” → “ability < 5. OR During battle, draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. LOST: Cancel”; the errata mark “E” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none); this version is the errata-sheet slip (a different printing from the card image before it). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “Rescue In The Clouds”. Text: “USED: At a system or Bespin location, choose: Cancel a just drawn destiny targeting the ability or defense value of your non-Undercover character of ability < 5. OR During battle, draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. LOST: Cancel Close Call.”
